## Annex 7 — Reference Architecture and Implementation

Etiquetas: Autoridad, permisos y delegación 11.11%; Decisiones y responsabilidad 11.11%; Investigación y documentación técnica 27.78%; Evidencia, procedencia y atribución 11.11%; Transformación y continuidad operativa 38.89%
Ficha: https://dakleyer.github.io/perspective-beyond/sources/annex-7-reference-architecture-and-implementation-t2807/
Documento de origen: https://tegrity.ai/when-the-controls-work-annex-7-reference-architecture-and-implementation/

relations.title: Japan Enterprise Architecture Function
relations.reading: The Japan case offers an organizational comparison for context-preserving handoffs between distinct decision owners.

relations.title: Case Study: Weatherford Multi-Level Information Management for Oilfield Supplier Management
relations.reading: The supplier case shows why evidence handoff needs the decision context that makes a document meaningful.

relations.title: Phylons predictive factors cascade
relations.reading: Materialized context and epistemic handoff share a need for explicit validity conditions, although they represent different objects.

relations.title: Greater China Robotics
relations.reading: Architectural translation could preserve not only interface fields but also their meaning, authority and validity conditions at each receiving operation.

relations.title: Distributed Tiger Teams VS Freelancer Swarms
relations.reading: Shared mission accountability does not erase the distinct authority conditions that must accompany a handoff between operational owners.

relations.title: Distributed Operational Intelligence Across the Americas
relations.reading: Cross-border operational handoffs should preserve the responsible entity, jurisdiction and delegated scope rather than treating continuity as uniform authority.

relations.title: Case Study: Chicontepec Megaproject
relations.reading: The contracting vehicle, decision owner and execution platform remain distinct even when they participate in the same operational handoff.

relations.title: Car Evolution Mobility OS – Product Annex
relations.reading: A cross-operator assignment should carry the context and acceptance conditions that allow each responsible operator to authorize its own action.

relations.title: Dos maneras de cruzar un mundo Arquitecturas que empobrecen vs arquitecturas que multiplican
relations.reading: A generative boundary can inspire an interface design that shares enough context for safe coordination without requiring both sides to adopt an identical internal model.

relations.title: Information Management as Operational Tracking
relations.reading: For a complementary reading, see [Operational tracking as a historical comparison](https://jubap.net/information-management-as-operational-tracking/).
